name: GE Vernova T&D India Limited
summary: GE Vernova T&D India Limited engages in power transmission and distribution business in India and internationally. It offers grid solutions for generation, transmission, distribution, and industries and infrastructures, such as HVDC/FACTS, AC substations solution and services for system integration; HV/MV equipment, including circuit breakers, disconnectors, instrument transformers, power transformers, capacitors, and reactors; and automation protection comprising digital substations, asset performance and energy management.
